errors.text: Equity is now {{FY2025.balance.equity}}. *Mitigant:* the covenant package proposed in Section 8.
**Rate caps only pay above their strikes.** The caps protect only once SOFR rises above the strike.
One threshold breaks: debt to EBITDA rises above our leverage limit.
The real risk under stress is leverage, not cash service.
Leverage is the weakest part of the grade, and debt service is the strongest.
The main concern is behaviour, not capacity.
The conditions below address each of these points.
